# CSV Example Event

One real event followed through the eic2ai CSV files: which rows it has, and how the row numbers in one file lead to
rows of another. The event is event 0 of a 2026-11 Sullivan-process file, e p → e′ K⁺ Λ at 9 × 100 GeV, simulated
and reconstructed with eic_xl 26.11. [CSV Schema](./csv-schema) lists every column.

## Rows per file

The first 100 events of that file. Every file has the column `evt`; the rows of one event share it.

| File | One row is | Rows per event | Columns |
| ---- | ---------- | -------------: | ------: |
| [`trk_hits`](./csv-schema#trk_hits) | one tracker hit, with the MC particle that made it | 22 | 36 |
| [`cal_hits`](./csv-schema#cal_hits) | one calorimeter hit, labeled from the simulated cell | 568 | 36 |
| [`calo_clusters`](./csv-schema#calo_clusters) | one cluster ↔ MC particle link; the rows of one cluster share (evt, clu_collection, clu_index) | 46 | 43 |
| [`event_index`](./csv-schema#event_index) | one processed event | 1 | 4 |
| [`mc_dis`](./csv-schema#mc_dis) | one event, with the generator's DIS kinematics | 1 | 21 |
| [`mc_particles`](./csv-schema#mc_particles) | one simulated particle | 7,804 | 22 |
| [`reco_particles`](./csv-schema#reco_particles) | one reconstructed particle | 2 | 21 |
| [`reco_dis`](./csv-schema#reco_dis) | one event, with reconstructed and true DIS kinematics | 1 | 100 |
| [`reco_ff_lambda`](./csv-schema#reco_ff_lambda) | one far-forward Λ reconstructed as n γ γ (none in this sample) | 0 | 109 |
| [`mcpart_lambda`](./csv-schema#mcpart_lambda) | one generated Λ with its decay products | 1.9 | 115 |
| [`lambda_acceptance`](./csv-schema#lambda_acceptance) | one event, with the Λ → p π⁻ acceptance ledger | 1 | 25 |
| [`acceptance_ppim`](./csv-schema#acceptance_ppim) | one event with a Λ → p π⁻, with per-detector hit flags | 0.7 | 97 |
| [`acceptance_ppim_prot_hits`](./csv-schema#acceptance_ppim_prot_hits) | one hit of the Λ's proton | 20 | 10 |
| [`acceptance_ppim_pimin_hits`](./csv-schema#acceptance_ppim_pimin_hits) | one hit of the Λ's π⁻ | 8.4 | 10 |
| [`acceptance_npi0`](./csv-schema#acceptance_npi0) | one event, with the first Λ and n π⁰ → n γ γ detection flags | 1 | 124 |
| [`combinatorics_ppim`](./csv-schema#combinatorics_ppim) | one (proton candidate, pion candidate) pair (none in this sample) | 0 | 48 |
| [`comb_candidates`](./csv-schema#comb_candidates) | one proton or π⁻ candidate | 2.3 | 27 |
| [`comb_candidates_events`](./csv-schema#comb_candidates_events) | one event, with the first Λ's truth summary | 1 | 17 |

## Event 0 through the files

The Λ decays to n π⁰ at z = 4.75 m. One π⁰ photon reaches the ZDC; the other converts to e⁻ e⁺ at z = 5.80 m and
leaves hits in the B0 tracker. The neutron interacts at z = 7.11 m; a B0ECal cell names a proton made there.

<figcaption>Boxes on the left: rows of <code>mc_particles</code> (#n is <code>prt_index</code>); the lines between them are <code>prt_parent_index</code>. Highlighted boxes: generator particles (<code>prt_gen_status</code> 1), where every walk up the parents ends. Cards on the right: real rows of <code>cal_hits</code>, <code>trk_hits</code> and <code>calo_clusters</code>; the dashed arrow is the row's <code>prt_index</code>. The B0ECal cluster has two rows, one per particle that put energy into it.</figcaption>
</figure>

| Column of a hit row | What it holds | ZDC hit | B0 tracker hit |
| ------------------- | ------------- | ------- | -------------- |
| `prt_index` | the saved particle Geant4 credited with the energy | 6383 γ | 6385 e⁻ |
| `prt_primary_index` | the generator particle it comes from | 4 Λ | 4 Λ |
| `prt_primary_child_index` | the particle one step below that | 5 π⁰ | 5 π⁰ |

`prt_gen_status`: 4 beam, 1 generator particle (a primary), 2 decayed by the generator, 0 made by Geant4 (a
secondary). Event 0 has 8,151 rows in `mc_particles`: 5 from the generator, 8,146 made by Geant4
(3,436 γ, 3,210 e⁻, 911 e⁺, 309 n, 133 p, …). It has 36 tracker hits, 787 calorimeter cell hits and
32 clusters in 40 cluster rows.
